# WaterPilot — Coverage matrix and data readiness

<!-- Generated by `npm run coverage-matrix` from `waterpilot.domain.readiness` and
     `docs/domain/capability-matrix.json`. Do not edit by hand; a test checks drift. -->

What WaterPilot can show for an area depends on imported, licence-reviewed and validated
sources, plus values a person enters. This file lists what the runtime gate requires
(`docs/domain/data-readiness-gate.md`, ADR 0008); `docs/data/ingestion-runbook.md`
explains how a source is registered, reviewed and imported.

## Status

- **No real source is registered or imported.** For every real area, every capability
  below is `unavailable` until a source passes licence review, ingestion and
  validation. Live ingestion against GCP is **pending** (not verified).
- Candidate source families come from `capability-matrix.json`. They are **not
  registered**: each needs a licence review and confirmation of its coverage and
  dates before use. Google Earth Engine is not assumed to be available.
- Demo-only sources (synthetic, never shown in pilot mode): synthetic-utility-supply-demo.
- Reviewed models: none. Capabilities that need one stay `partial` at best.
- Reporting windows and freshness bounds are **PROPOSED** and need domain review.

Readiness states, from best to worst: `available` (validated, licensed, in coverage and
fresh), `user_entered` (typed in by the person, with a source note), `partial`
(usable with a caveat), `stale` (too old) and `unavailable`. Missing data is never
shown as zero.

## Inputs

| Input               | Label                                | Unit      | Source capability | Manual entry | Max age   | Arrives with |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------ | --------- | ----------------- | ------------ | --------- | ------------ |
| daily_demand        | Daily water use                      | L/day     | none defined      | yes          | 365 days  | -            |
| population          | Population served                    | count     | none defined      | yes          | 3653 days | -            |
| per_capita_standard | Per-person daily water need          | L/day     | none defined      | yes          | none      | -            |
| non_domestic_demand | Non-domestic demand                  | L/day     | none defined      | yes          | 365 days  | -            |
| delivered_supply    | Delivered supply                     | L/day     | utility_supply    | yes          | 45 days   | -            |
| tanker_supply       | Tanker supply                        | L/day     | utility_supply    | yes          | 45 days   | -            |
| forward_series      | Forward supply and demand projection | L/day     | none defined      | no           | none      | Prompt 11    |
| intervention_costs  | Costed interventions                 | INR_paise | none defined      | no           | none      | Prompt 13    |
| unit_price          | Dated water unit price               | INR_paise | none defined      | no           | none      | Prompt 13    |
| om_costs            | Operation and maintenance costs      | INR_paise | none defined      | no           | none      | Prompt 13    |

## Metrics

| Metric                  | Required inputs                                   | Optional inputs     | Daily series | Typed-in values only |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- | ------------------- | ------------ | -------------------- |
| average_supply_gap      | delivered_supply, population, per_capita_standard | non_domestic_demand | no           | user_entered         |
| demand                  | population, per_capita_standard                   | non_domestic_demand | no           | user_entered         |
| delivered_supply        | delivered_supply                                  | -                   | no           | user_entered         |
| reliable_supply         | delivered_supply                                  | -                   | yes          | unavailable          |
| dependable_supply_ratio | delivered_supply, population, per_capita_standard | non_domestic_demand | yes          | unavailable          |
| deficit                 | delivered_supply, population, per_capita_standard | non_domestic_demand | yes          | unavailable          |
| shortage_days           | delivered_supply, population, per_capita_standard | non_domestic_demand | yes          | unavailable          |
| volume_reliability      | delivered_supply, population, per_capita_standard | non_domestic_demand | yes          | unavailable          |
| time_reliability        | delivered_supply, population, per_capita_standard | non_domestic_demand | yes          | unavailable          |
| days_until_shortage     | forward_series                                    | -                   | no           | unavailable          |
| tanker_dependence       | tanker_supply, delivered_supply                   | -                   | no           | user_entered         |
| project_cost            | intervention_costs                                | -                   | no           | unavailable          |
| avoided_cost            | intervention_costs, unit_price                    | -                   | no           | unavailable          |
| net_benefit             | intervention_costs, unit_price, om_costs          | -                   | no           | unavailable          |
| payback_period          | intervention_costs, unit_price, om_costs          | -                   | no           | unavailable          |

`Typed-in values only` is the best state a metric reaches when a person enters every
input that allows it and nothing is imported. Metrics that need a daily series stay
`unavailable` until a validated source supplies one.
